Fichiers attendus\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","fichiers_horizons = {\n","    \"Io\": Path(\"Io_Horizons_Jovicentric_Vector_2026_1h_RAW.csv\"),\n","    \"Europa\": Path(\"Europa_Horizons_Jovicentric_Vector_2026_1h_RAW.csv\"),\n","    \"Ganymede\": Path(\"Ganymede_Horizons_Jovicentric_Vector_2026_1h_RAW.csv\")\n","}\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 2. Fonction de nettoyage des noms de colonnes\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","def nettoyer_nom_colonne(nom):\n","    \"\"\"\n","    Nettoie un nom de colonne provenant de JPL Horizons.\n","    \"\"\"\n","    nom = str(nom).strip()\n","    nom = nom.replace('\"', \"\")\n","    nom = nom.replace(\" \", \"_\")\n","    nom = nom.replace(\"(\", \"\")\n","    nom = nom.replace(\")\", \"\")\n","    nom = nom.replace(\"/\", \"_\")\n","    nom = re.sub(r\"_+\", \"_\", nom)\n","\n","    return nom.strip(\"_\")\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 3. Fonction de lecture d'un fichier Horizons RAW\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","def lire_horizons_raw(chemin):\n","    \"\"\"\n","    Lit un fichier brut JPL Horizons.\n","\n","    La fonction :\n","    - localise $$SOE et $$EOE ;\n","    - extrait uniquement les données ;\n","    - récupère l'en-tête situé avant $$SOE ;\n","    - supprime les colonnes entièrement vides ;\n","    - convertit les colonnes numériques.\n","    \"\"\"\n","\n","    chemin = Path(chemin)\n","\n","    if not chemin.exists():\n","        raise FileNotFoundError(\n","            f\"Fichier introuvable : {chemin}\"\n","        )\n","\n","    # Lecture texte robuste\n","    texte = chemin.read_text(\n","        encoding=\"utf-8\",\n","        errors=\"replace\"\n","    )\n","\n","    lignes = texte.splitlines()\n","\n","    # Localisation des marqueurs Horizons\n","    indices_soe = [\n","        i for i, ligne in enumerate(lignes)\n","        if \"$$SOE\" in ligne\n","    ]\n","\n","    indices_eoe = [\n","        i for i, ligne in enumerate(lignes)\n","        if \"$$EOE\" in ligne\n","    ]\n","\n","    if not indices_soe:\n","        raise ValueError(\n","            f\"Marqueur $$SOE absent dans {chemin.name}\"\n","        )\n","\n","    if not indices_eoe:\n","        raise ValueError(\n","            f\"Marqueur $$EOE absent dans {chemin.name}\"\n","        )\n","\n","    debut = indices_soe[0]\n","    fin = next(\n","        i for i in indices_eoe\n","        if i > debut\n","    )\n","\n","    # --------------------------------------------------------\n","    # Recherche de l'en-tête CSV avant $$SOE\n","    # --------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","    ligne_entete = None\n","\n","    for i in range(debut - 1, max(-1, debut - 30), -1):\n","        candidate = lignes[i].strip()\n","\n","        if (\n","            \",\" in candidate\n","            and not candidate.startswith(\"*\")\n","            and not candidate.startswith(\"!\")\n","            and not candidate.startswith(\"$$\")\n","        ):\n","            ligne_entete = candidate\n","            break\n","\n","    # --------------------------------------------------------\n","    # Extraction des lignes de données\n","    # --------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","    lignes_donnees = [\n","        ligne.strip()\n","        for ligne in lignes[debut + 1:fin]\n","        if ligne.strip()\n","    ]\n","\n","    if not lignes_donnees:\n","        raise ValueError(\n","            f\"Aucune donnée entre $$SOE et $$EOE dans {chemin.name}\"\n","        )\n","\n","    # Suppression des virgules terminales éventuelles\n","    lignes_donnees = [\n","        ligne.rstrip(\",\")\n","        for ligne in lignes_donnees\n","    ]\n","\n","    # --------------------------------------------------------\n","    # Lecture avec le module csv\n","    # --------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","    lignes_parsees = list(\n","        csv.reader(\n","            lignes_donnees,\n","            skipinitialspace=True\n","        )\n","    )\n","\n","    nombre_colonnes = max(\n","        len(ligne) for ligne in lignes_parsees\n","    )\n","\n","    # Uniformisation du nombre de colonnes\n","    lignes_parsees = [\n","        ligne + [\"\"] * (nombre_colonnes - len(ligne))\n","        for ligne in lignes_parsees\n","    ]\n","\n","    # --------------------------------------------------------\n","    # Détermination des noms de colonnes\n","    # --------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","    if ligne_entete is not None:\n","        colonnes = next(\n","            csv.reader(\n","                [ligne_entete],\n","                skipinitialspace=True\n","            )\n","        )\n","\n","        colonnes = [\n","            nettoyer_nom_colonne(c)\n","            for c in colonnes\n","        ]\n","\n","    else:\n","        colonnes = []\n","\n","    # Ajustement si l'en-tête ne correspond pas exactement\n","    if len(colonnes) < nombre_colonnes:\n","        colonnes += [\n","            f\"colonne_{i + 1}\"\n","            for i in range(\n","                len(colonnes),\n","                nombre_colonnes\n","            )\n","        ]\n","\n","    elif len(colonnes) > nombre_colonnes:\n","        colonnes = colonnes[:nombre_colonnes]\n","\n","    # Noms vides ou dupliqués\n","    colonnes_finales = []\n","    compteurs = {}\n","\n","    for i, colonne in enumerate(colonnes):\n","        if not colonne:\n","            colonne = f\"colonne_{i + 1}\"\n","\n","        if colonne in compteurs:\n","            compteurs[colonne] += 1\n","            colonne = f\"{colonne}_{compteurs[colonne]}\"\n","        else:\n","            compteurs[colonne] = 1\n","\n","        colonnes_finales.append(colonne)\n","\n","    # --------------------------------------------------------\n","    # Construction du DataFrame\n","    # --------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","    df = pd.DataFrame(\n","        lignes_parsees,\n","        columns=colonnes_finales\n","    )\n","\n","    # Nettoyage des espaces\n","    for colonne in df.columns:\n","        if df[colonne].dtype == \"object\":\n","            df[colonne] = df[colonne].astype(str).str.strip()\n","\n","    # Remplacement des chaînes vides\n","    df = df.replace(\n","        {\n","            \"\": pd.NA,\n","            \"n.a.\": pd.NA,\n","            \"N.A.\": pd.NA,\n","            \"nan\": pd.NA\n","        }\n","    )\n","\n","    # Suppression des colonnes totalement vides\n","    df = df.dropna(\n","        axis=1,\n","        how=\"all\"\n","    )\n","\n","    # --------------------------------------------------------\n","    # Conversion automatique des colonnes numériques\n","    # --------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","    for colonne in df.columns:\n","        serie_numerique = pd.to_numeric(\n","            df[colonne],\n","            errors=\"coerce\"\n","        )\n","\n","        proportion_numerique = serie_numerique.notna().mean()\n","\n","        # Conversion si au moins 90 % des valeurs sont numériques\n","        if proportion_numerique >= 0.90:\n","            df[colonne] = serie_numerique\n","\n","    return df\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 4. Chargement des trois satellites\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","donnees = {}\n","\n","print(\"Chargement des fichiers Horizons RAW...\\n\")\n","\n","for satellite, chemin in fichiers_horizons.items():\n","\n","    try:\n","        df = lire_horizons_raw(chemin)\n","\n","        donnees[satellite] = df\n","\n","        print(\n","            f\"{satellite:10s} : \"\n","            f\"{df.shape[0]} lignes × \"\n","            f\"{df.shape[1]} colonnes\"\n","        )\n","\n","    except Exception as erreur:\n","        print(f\"{satellite:10s} : ERREUR\")\n","        print(f\"  {erreur}\")\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 5. Inspection des colonnes et premières lignes\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","for satellite, df in donnees.items():\n","\n","    print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 80)\n","    print(satellite)\n","    print(\"=\" * 80)\n","\n","    print(\"\\nColonnes détectées :\")\n","\n","    for i, colonne in enumerate(df.columns, start=1):\n","        print(\n","            f\"{i:2d}. {colonne} \"\n","            f\"— type : {df[colonne].dtype}\"\n","        )\n","\n","    print(\"\\nPremières lignes :\")\n","    display(df.head(3))\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 6. Vérification des dimensions\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","print(\"\\nRésumé des dimensions :\\n\")\n","\n","for satellite in [\"Io\", \"Europa\", \"Ganymede\"]:\n","\n","    if satellite in donnees:\n","        df = donnees[satellite]\n","\n","        print(\n","            f\"{satellite:10s} : \"\n","            f\"{len(df)} états temporels\"\n","        )\n","\n","    else:\n","        print(\n","            f\"{satellite:10s} : non chargé\"\n","        )\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 7. Recherche des colonnes communes exactes\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","if len(donnees) == 3:\n","\n","    colonnes_communes = sorted(\n","        set(donnees[\"Io\"].columns)\n","        & set(donnees[\"Europa\"].columns)\n","        & set(donnees[\"Ganymede\"].columns)\n","    )\n","\n","    print(\"\\nColonnes communes aux trois satellites :\\n\")\n","\n","    for colonne in colonnes_communes:\n","        print(\"-\", colonne)\n","\n","else:\n","    colonnes_communes = []\n","\n","    print(\n","        \"\\nLes trois fichiers doivent être chargés \"\n","        \"avant de rechercher les colonnes communes.\"\n","    )\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 8. Colonnes numériques communes\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","colonnes_numeriques_communes = []\n","\n","if len(donnees) == 3:\n","\n","    for colonne in colonnes_communes:\n","\n","        est_numerique_partout = all(\n","            pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(\n","                donnees[satellite][colonne]\n","            )\n","            for satellite in [\n","                \"Io\",\n","                \"Europa\",\n","                \"Ganymede\"\n","            ]\n","        )\n","\n","        if est_numerique_partout:\n","            colonnes_numeriques_communes.append(colonne)\n","\n","    print(\"\\nColonnes numériques communes :\\n\")\n","\n","    for colonne in colonnes_numeriques_communes:\n","        print(\"-\", colonne)"],"metadata":{"colab":{"base_uri":"https://localhost:8080/","height":1000},"id":"x-5_NXCWVmXU","executionInfo":{"status":"ok","timestamp":1784517430850,"user_tz":300,"elapsed":1338,"user":{"displayName":"charlemagne oreste Laurince","userId":"04059779535451209712"}},"outputId":"45e00656-f1c7-4d63-946b-097b6d0c9c93"},"execution_count":null,"outputs":[{"output_type":"stream","name":"stdout","text":["Chargement des fichiers Horizons RAW...\n","\n","Io         : 35044 lignes × 1 colonnes\n","Europa     : 8761 lignes × 11 colonnes\n","Ganymede   : 8761 lignes × 11 colonnes\n","\n","================================================================================\n","Io\n","================================================================================\n","\n","Colonnes détectées :\n"," 1. Recherche de l'en-tête avant $$SOE\n","    entete = None\n","\n","    for i in range(debut - 1, max(-1, debut - 30), -1):\n","        ligne = lignes[i].strip()\n","\n","        if (\n","            \"JDTDB\" in ligne\n","            and \"Calendar Date\" in ligne\n","            and \",\" in ligne\n","        ):\n","            entete = ligne\n","            break\n","\n","    if entete is None:\n","        raise ValueError(\n","            f\"En-tête tabulaire introuvable dans {chemin}\"\n","        )\n","\n","    donnees_brutes = [\n","        ligne.rstrip(\",\")\n","        for ligne in lignes[debut + 1:fin]\n","        if ligne.strip()\n","    ]\n","\n","    bloc = \"\\n\".join([entete] + donnees_brutes)\n","\n","    from io import StringIO\n","\n","    df = pd.read_csv(\n","        StringIO(bloc),\n","        skipinitialspace=True\n","    )\n","\n","    #     motif,\n","        ligne\n","    )\n","\n","    if resultat is None:\n","        return np.nan\n","\n","    return float(resultat.group(1))\n","\n","\n","def lire_io_multiligne(chemin):\n","    \"\"\"\n","    Lit le fichier Io Horizons où chaque époque est répartie\n","    sur quatre lignes :\n","    date, position, vitesse, grandeurs dérivées.\n","    \"\"\"\n","\n","    texte = )\n","\n","    lignes_donnees = [\n","        ligne.strip()\n","        for ligne in lignes[debut + 1:fin]\n","        if ligne.strip()\n","    ]\n","\n","    observations = []\n","    i = 0\n","\n","        continue\n","\n","        if i + 3 >= len(lignes_donnees):\n","            break\n","\n","        ligne_position = lignes_donnees[i + 1]\n","        ligne_vitesse = lignes_donnees[i + 2]\n","        ligne_derivees = lignes_donnees[i + 3]\n","\n","        observation = {\n","            \"JDTDB\": float(resultat_date.group(1)),\n","            \"Calendar_Date_TDB\":        ligne_vitesse, \"VX\"\n","            ),\n","            \"VY\": extraire_valeur(\n","                ligne_vitesse, \"VY\"\n","            ),\n","            \"VZ\": extraire_valeur(\n"," }\n","\n","        observations.append(observation)\n","\n","        i += 4\n","\n","    df = pd.DataFrame(observations)\n","\n","    colonnes = [\n","        \"JDTDB\",\n","        \"Calendar_Date_TDB\",\n","        \"X\", \"Y\", \"Z\",\n","        \"VX\", \"VY\", \"VZ\",\n","        \"LT\", \"RG\", \"RR\"\n","    ]\n","\n","    if df.empty:\n","        raise ValueError(\n","            \"Aucune observation Io n'a été reconstruite.\"\n","        )\n","\n","    return df[colonnes]\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 4. X_tilde\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","import numpy as np\n","import pandas as pd\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 1. Paramètres de normalisation\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","moyenne_etat = np.mean(\n","    X_collectif,\n","    axis=0\n",")\n","\n","ecart_type_etat = np.std(\n","    X_collectif,\n","    axis=0,\n","    ddof=0\n",")\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 2. Vérification des échelles non nulles\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","indices_ecart_nul = np.where(\n","    ecart_type_etat == 0\n",")[0]\n","\n","if len(indices_ecart_nul) > 0:\n","\n","    composantes_problematiques = [\n","        colonnes_etat[i]\n","        for i in indices_ecart_nul\n","    ]\n","\n","    raise ValueError(\n","        \"Écart-type nul pour les composantes suivantes : \"\n","        f\"{composantes_problematiques}\"\n","    )\n","\n","print(\"Tous les écarts-types sont strictement positifs : VALIDÉ\")\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 3. Normalisation de l'état\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","X_normalise = (\n","    X_collectif - moyenne_etat\n",") / ecart_type_etat\n","\n","print(\"\\nÉtat normalisé construit.\")\n","print(\"Forme de X_normalise :\", X_normalise.shape)\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 4. Calcul de la transition normalisée\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","Delta_X_normalise = np.diff(\n","    X_normalise,\n","    axis=0\n",")\n","\n","print(\n","    \"Forme de Delta_X_normalise :\",\n","    Delta_X_normalise.shape\n",")\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 5. Vérification de la définition mathématique\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","Delta_X_normalise_direct = (\n","    X_collectif[1:] - X_collectif[:-1]\n",") / ecart_type_etat\n","\n","erreur_equivalence = np.max(\n","    np.abs(\n","        Delta_X_normalise\n","        -\n","        Delta_X_normalise_direct\n","    )\n",")\n","\n","equivalence_validee = np.allclose(\n","    Delta_X_normalise,\n","    Delta_X_normalise_direct,\n","    rtol=1e-12,\n","    atol=1e-12\n",")\n","\n","print(\"\\nVérification :\")\n","print(\n","    \"Delta X_tilde = \"\n","    \"N(X_{k+1}) - N(X_k) :\",\n","    equivalence_validee\n",")\n","\n","print(\n","    \"Erreur maximale d'équivalence :\",\n","    f\"{erreur_equivalence:.3e}\"\n",")\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 6. Contrôles statistiques de la normalisation\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","moyennes_normalisees = np.mean(\n","    X_normalise,\n","    axis=0\n",")\n","\n","ecarts_types_normalises = np.std(\n","    X_normalise,\n","    axis=0,\n","    ddof=0\n",")\n","\n","erreur_moyenne_max = np.max(\n","    np.abs(moyennes_normalisees)\n",")\n","\n","erreur_ecart_type_max = np.max(\n","    np.abs(ecarts_types_normalises - 1.0)\n",")\n","\n","print(\"\\nContrôles de normalisation :\")\n","print(\n","    \"- Moyenne absolue maximale :\",\n","    f\"{erreur_moyenne_max:.3e}\"\n",")\n","print(\n","    \"- Écart maximal à sigma = 1 :\",\n","    f\"{erreur_ecart_type_max:.3e}\"\n",")\n","print(\n","    \"- Absence de NaN :\",\n","    not np.isnan(X_normalise).any()\n",")\n","print(\n","    \"- Valeurs finies :\",\n","    np.isfinite(X_normalise).all()\n",")\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 7. Tableau des paramètres de normalisation\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","parametres_normalisation_df = pd.DataFrame({\n","    \"Composante\": colonnes_etat,\n","    \"Moyenne\": moyenne_etat,\n","    \"Ecart_type\": ecart_type_etat\n","})\n","\n","print(\"\\nParamètres de normalisation :\")\n","display(parametres_normalisation_df)\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 8. colonne in colonnes_etat\n","]\n","\n","Delta_X_normalise_df = pd.DataFrame(\n","    Delta_X_normalise,\n","    columns=colonnes_transition_normalisee\n",")\n","\n","Delta_X_normalise_df.insert(\n"," :\")\n","display(Delta_X_normalise_df.head(3))"],"metadata":{"colab":{"base_uri":"https://localhost:8080/","height":1000},"id":"NwWQEOqLiI5h","executionInfo":{"status":"ok","timestamp":1784517485879,"user_tz":300,"elapsed":172,"user":{"displayName":"charlemagne Axes>"],"image/png":"\n"},"metadata":{}}]},{"cell_type":"markdown","source":["### Résultat numérique fondamental\n","\n","L'application aux trajectoires jovicentriques de Io, Europa et\n","Ganymède permet de construire un état collectif\n","\n","\\[\n","X_k \\in \\mathbb{R}^{18},\n","\\]\n","\n","composé des positions et vitesses des trois satellites.\n","\n","Après normalisation composante par composante, la transition dynamique\n","est définie par\n","\n","\\[\n","\\Delta\\widetilde X_k\n","=\n","\\widetilde X_{k+1}\n","-\n","\\widetilde X_k.\n","\\]\n","\n","La première observable fondamentale de GVH est alors\n","\n","\\[\n","D_T(k)\n","=\n","\\left\\|\n","\\Delta\\widetilde X_k\n","\\right\\|_2.\n","\\]\n","\n","Le calcul numérique sur 8760 transitions horaires donne\n","\n","\\[\n","\\overline{D_T}=0.414467,\n","\\qquad\n","\\sigma(D_T)=0.001613,\n","\\]\n","\n","avec\n","\n","\\[\n","0.412056\n","\\leq D_T(k)\n","\\leq\n","0.417890.\n","\\]\n","\n","L'identité métrique\n","\n","\\[\n","D_T(k)\n","=\n","d(\n","\\widetilde X_k,\n","\\widetilde X_{k+1}\n",")\n","\\]\n","\n","est vérifiée numériquement avec une erreur maximale nulle à la\n","précision de calcul.\n","\n","La décomposition par satellite satisfait également\n","\n","\\[\n","D_T(k)^2\n","=\n","D_{T,\\mathrm{Io}}(k)^2\n","+\n","D_{T,\\mathrm{Europa}}(k)^2\n","+\n","D_{T,\\mathrm{Ganymede}}(k)^2,\n","\\]\n","\n","avec une erreur maximale de \\(1.665\\times10^{-16}\\).\n","\n","Cette application établit que \\(D_T\\) n'est pas seulement une distance\n","abstraite : elle représente la norme de la transition dynamique\n","observée entre deux états successifs du système normalisé."],"metadata":{"id":"EESaEJO7jeB4"}},{"cell_type":"code","source":["# ============================================================\n","# Formalisation de S_T et S_T_norm\n","# Système collectif + contributions individuelles\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","import numpy as np\n","import pandas as pd\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 1. Fonction de calcul\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","def calculer_variabilite_transition(\n","    distances,\n","    nom_systeme\n","):\n","    \"\"\"\n","    Calcule les observables de variabilité de la norme de transition.\n","\n","    Paramètres\n","    ----------\n","    distances : array-like\n","        Série temporelle D_T(k).\n","    nom_systeme : str\n","        Nom du système ou du satellite.\n","\n","    Retour\n","    ------\n","    dict\n","        Résumé contenant :\n","        - nombre de transitions ;\n","        - moyenne de D_T ;\n","        - S_T ;\n","        - S_T_norm ;\n","        - variance ;\n","        - minimum et maximum.\n","    \"\"\"\n","\n","    distances = np.asarray(\n","        distances,\n","        dtype=float\n","    )\n","\n","    # Contrôles d'intégrité\n","    if distances.ndim != 1:\n","        raise ValueError(\n","            f\"{nom_systeme} : D_T doit être un vecteur unidimensionnel.\"\n","        )\n","\n","    if distances.size == 0:\n","        raise ValueError(\n","            f\"{nom_systeme} : la série D_T est vide.\"\n","        )\n","\n","    if not np.isfinite(distances).all():\n","        raise ValueError(\n","            f\"{nom_systeme} : D_T contient des valeurs non finies.\"\n","        )\n","\n","    if np.any(distances < 0):\n","        raise ValueError(\n","            f\"{nom_systeme} : D_T contient des valeurs négatives.\"\n","        )\n","\n","    # Moyenne de la norme de transition\n","    D_T_mean = np.mean(\n","        distances\n","    )\n","\n","    # Écart-type population\n","    S_T = np.std(\n","        distances,\n","        ddof=0\n","    )\n","\n","    # Variance correspondante\n","    variance_D_T = np.var(\n","        distances,\n","        ddof=0\n","    )\n","\n","    # Variabilité relative\n","    if np.isclose(D_T_mean, 0.0):\n","        S_T_norm = np.nan\n","    else:\n","        S_T_norm = S_T / D_T_mean\n","\n","    return {\n","        \"Systeme\": nom_systeme,\n","        \"N_transitions\": distances.size,\n","        \"D_T_mean\": D_T_mean,\n","        \"S_T\": S_T,\n","        \"S_T_norm\": S_T_norm,\n","        \"S_T_norm_percent\": 100.0 * S_T_norm,\n","        \"Variance_D_T\": variance_D_T,\n","        \"D_T_min\": np.min(distances),\n","        \"D_T_max\": np.max(distances)\n","    }\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 2. Calcul pour le système collectif\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","resultat_collectif = calculer_variabilite_transition(\n","    D_T,\n","    \"Io-Europa-Ganymede collectif\"\n",")\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 3. Calcul pour chaque satellite\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","resultat_Io = calculer_variabilite_transition(\n","    D_T_Io,\n","    \"Io\"\n",")\n","\n","resultat_Europa = calculer_variabilite_transition(\n","    D_T_Europa,\n","    \"Europa\"\n",")\n","\n","resultat_Ganymede = calculer_variabilite_transition(\n","    D_T_Ganymede,\n","    \"Ganymede\"\n",")\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 4. Tableau récapitulatif\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","resume_S_T_df = pd.DataFrame([\n","    resultat_collectif,\n","    resultat_Io,\n","    resultat_Europa,\n","    resultat_Ganymede\n","])\n","\n","print(\"Observables S_T et S_T_norm calculées.\")\n","display(resume_S_T_df)\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 5. Extraction explicite des observables collectives\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","S_T = resultat_collectif[\"S_T\"]\n","S_T_norm = resultat_collectif[\"S_T_norm\"]\n","\n","S_T_Io = resultat_Io[\"S_T\"]\n","S_T_norm_Io = resultat_Io[\"S_T_norm\"]\n","\n","S_T_Europa = resultat_Europa[\"S_T\"]\n","S_T_norm_Europa = resultat_Europa[\"S_T_norm\"]\n","\n","S_T_Ganymede = resultat_Ganymede[\"S_T\"]\n","S_T_norm_Ganymede = resultat_Ganymede[\"S_T_norm\"]\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 6. transition\n","\n","\\[\n","D_T(1),D_T(2),\\ldots,D_T(N_T).\n","\\]\n","\n","La norme moyenne de transition est définie par\n","\n","\\[\n","\\overline{D_T}\n","=\n","\\frac{1}{N_T}\n","\\sum_{k=1}^{N_T}D_T(k).\n","\\]\n","\n","L'observable de variabilité absolue est définie par\n","\n","\\[\n","\\boxed{\n","S_T\n","=\n","\\sqrt{\n","\\frac{1}{N_T}\n","\\sum_{k=1}^{N_T}\n","\\left(\n","D_T(k)-\\overline{D_T}\n","\\right)^2\n","}\n","}\n","\\]\n","\n","Elle correspond à Cette observation décrit uniquement\n","la dispersion temporelle des normes de transition. Pas temporels étudiés\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","# Les données primitives sont horaires.\n","pas_heures = [1, 2, 3, 6, 12, 24]\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 2. Contrôles préalables\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","X_normalise = np.asarray(\n","    X_normalise,\n","    dtype=float\n",")\n","\n","if X_normalise.ndim != 2:\n","    raise ValueError(\n","        \"X_normalise doit être une matrice bidimensionnelle.\"\n","    )\n","\n","if X_normalise.shape[1] != 18:\n","    raise ValueError(\n","        \"L'état collectif normalisé doit contenir 18 composantes.\"\n","    )\n","\n","if not np.isfinite(X_normalise).all():\n","    raise ValueError(\n","        \"X_normalise contient des valeurs non finies.\"\n","    )\n","\n","n_etats = X_normalise.shape[0]\n","\n","print(\"Nombre d'états normalisés :\", n_etats)\n","print(\"Dimension de l'état collectif :\", X_normalise.shape[1])\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 3. Fonction de calcul pour un pas temporel donné\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","def calculer_observables_pas_temporel(\n","    X_norm,\n","    lag,\n","    pas_elementaire_heures=1.0\n","):\n","    \"\"\"\n","    Calcule D_T, S_T et S_T_norm pour un décalage temporel donné.\n","\n","    Paramètres\n","    ----------\n","    X_norm : ndarray, forme (N, 18)\n","        États collectifs déjà normalisés.\n","\n","    lag : int\n","        Nombre de pas élémentaires séparant deux états comparés.\n","\n","    pas_elementaire_heures : float\n","        Durée du pas primitif en heures.\n","\n","    Retour\n","    ------\n","    dict\n","        Séries D_T collectives et individuelles,\n","        ainsi que leurs statistiques.\n","    \"\"\"\n","\n","    if not isinstance(lag, (int, np.integer)):\n","        raise TypeError(\n","            \"lag doit être un entier.\"\n","        )\n","\n","    if lag <= 0:\n","        raise ValueError(\n","            \"lag doit être strictement positif.\"\n","        )\n","\n","    if lag >= X_norm.shape[0]:\n","        raise ValueError(\n","            \"lag est trop grand par rapport au nombre d'états.\"\n","        )\n","\n","    # Transition entre X_k et X_{k+lag}\n","    Delta_lag = (\n","        X_norm[lag:, :]\n","        -\n","        X_norm[:-lag, :]\n","    )\n","\n","    # Décomposition selon l'ordre déjà adopté :\n","    # colonnes 0:6   -> Io\n","    # colonnes 6:12  -> Europa\n","    # colonnes 12:18 -> Ganymede\n","\n","    Delta_Io = Delta_lag[:, 0:6]\n","    Delta_Europa = Delta_lag[:, 6:12]\n","    Delta_Ganymede = Delta_lag[:, 12:18]\n","\n","    # Normes de transition\n","    D_collectif = np.linalg.norm(\n","        Delta_lag,\n","        axis=1\n","    )\n","\n","    D_Io = np.linalg.norm(\n","        Delta_Io,\n","        axis=1\n","    )\n","\n","    D_Europa = np.linalg.norm(\n","        Delta_Europa,\n","        axis=1\n","    )\n","\n","    D_Ganymede = np.linalg.norm(\n","        Delta_Ganymede,\n","        axis=1\n","    )\n","\n","    # Vérification de la décomposition quadratique\n","    reconstruction = np.sqrt(\n","        D_Io**2\n","        +\n","        D_Europa**2\n","        +\n","        D_Ganymede**2\n","    )\n","\n","    erreur_decomposition = np.max(\n","        np.abs(\n","            D_collectif\n","            -\n","            reconstruction\n","        )\n","    )\n","\n","    decomposition_validee = np.allclose(\n","        D_collectif,\n","        reconstruction,\n","        rtol=1e-13,\n","        atol=1e-13\n","    )\n","\n","    def statistiques(D):\n","        moyenne = np.mean(D)\n","        ecart_type = np.std(\n","            D,\n","            ddof=0\n","        )\n","\n","        if np.isclose(moyenne, 0.0):\n","            ecart_type_norm = np.nan\n","        else:\n","            ecart_type_norm = (\n","                ecart_type\n","                /\n","                moyenne\n","            )\n","\n","        return {\n","            \"N_transitions\": D.size,\n","            \"D_T_mean\": moyenne,\n","            \"S_T\": ecart_type,\n","            \"S_T_norm\": ecart_type_norm,\n","            \"S_T_norm_percent\": 100.0 * ecart_type_norm,\n","            \"D_T_min\": np.min(D),\n","            \"D_T_median\": np.median(D),\n","            \"D_T_max\": np.max(D)\n","        }\n","\n","    return {\n","        \"lag\": lag,\n","        \"Delta_t_heures\": lag * pas_elementaire_heures,\n","        \"D_T_collectif\": D_collectif,\n","        \"D_T_Io\": D_Io,\n","        \"D_T_Europa\": D_Europa,\n","        \"D_T_Ganymede\": D_Ganymede,\n","        \"stats_collectif\": statistiques(D_collectif),\n","        \"stats_Io\": statistiques(D_Io),\n","        \"stats_Europa\": statistiques(D_Europa),\n","        \"stats_Ganymede\": statistiques(D_Ganymede),\n","        \"decomposition_validee\": decomposition_validee,\n","        \"erreur_decomposition\": erreur_decomposition\n","    }\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 4. Calcul pour tous les pas temporels\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","resultats_multi_pas = {}\n","\n","for lag in pas_heures:\n","\n","    resultat = calculer_observables_pas_temporel(\n","        X_norm=X_normalise,\n","        lag=lag,\n","        pas_elementaire_heures=1.0\n","    )\n","\n","    resultats_multi_pas[lag] = resultat\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 5. Construction du tableau collectif\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","lignes_collectif = []\n","\n","for lag, resultat in resultats_multi_pas.items():\n","\n","    stats = resultat[\"stats_collectif\"]\n","\n","    lignes_collectif.append({\n","        \"Delta_t_heures\": resultat[\"Delta_t_heures\"],\n","        \"N_transitions\": stats[\"N_transitions\"],\n","        \"D_T_mean\": stats[\"D_T_mean\"],\n","        \"S_T\": stats[\"S_T\"],\n","        \"S_T_norm\": stats[\"S_T_norm\"],\n","        \"S_T_norm_percent\": stats[\"S_T_norm_percent\"],\n","        \"D_T_min\": stats[\"D_T_min\"],\n","        \"D_T_median\": stats[\"D_T_median\"],\n","        \"D_T_max\": stats[\"D_T_max\"],\n","        \"D_T_mean_par_heure\":\n","            stats[\"D_T_mean\"]\n","            /\n","            resultat[\"Delta_t_heures\"],\n","        \"S_T_par_heure\":\n","            stats[\"S_T\"]\n","            /\n","            resultat[\"Delta_t_heures\"],\n","        \"Decomposition_validee\":\n","            resultat[\"decomposition_validee\"],\n","        \"Erreur_decomposition\":\n","            resultat[\"erreur_decomposition\"]\n","    })\n","\n","resume_multi_pas_collectif = pd.DataFrame(\n","    lignes_collectif\n",")\n","\n","print(\n","    \"\\nRobustesse temporelle — système collectif :\"\n",")\n","\n","display(\n","    resume_multi_pas_collectif\n",")\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 6. Tableau détaillé collectif + satellites\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","lignes_detaillees = []\n","\n","for lag, resultat in resultats_multi_pas.items():\n","\n","    groupes = {\n","        \"Collectif\": resultat[\"stats_collectif\"],\n","        \"Io\": resultat[\"stats_Io\"],\n","        \"Europa\": resultat[\"stats_Europa\"],\n","        \"Ganymede\": resultat[\"stats_Ganymede\"]\n","    }\n","\n","    for systeme, stats in groupes.items():\n","\n","        lignes_detaillees.append({\n","            \"Systeme\": systeme,\n","            \"Delta_t_heures\":\n","                resultat[\"Delta_t_heures\"],\n","            \"N_transitions\":\n","                stats[\"N_transitions\"],\n","            \"D_T_mean\":\n","                stats[\"D_T_mean\"],\n","            \"S_T\":\n","                stats[\"S_T\"],\n","            \"S_T_norm\":\n","                stats[\"S_T_norm\"],\n","            \"S_T_norm_percent\":\n","                stats[\"S_T_norm_percent\"],\n","            \"D_T_mean_par_heure\":\n","                stats[\"D_T_mean\"]\n","                /\n","                resultat[\"Delta_t_heures\"]\n","        })\n","\n","resume_multi_pas_detaille = pd.DataFrame(\n","    lignes_detaillees\n",")\n","\n","print(\n","    \"\\nRobustesse temporelle — collectif et satellites :\"\n",")\n","\n","display(\n","    resume_multi_pas_detaille\n",")\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 7. Vérification du cas de référence Delta t = 1 heure\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","resultat_1h = resultats_multi_pas[1]\n","\n","verification_D_T_1h = np.allclose(\n","    resultat_1h[\"D_T_collectif\"],\n","    D_T,\n","    rtol=1e-14,\n","    atol=1e-14\n",")\n","\n","erreur_D_T_1h = np.max(\n","    np.abs(\n","        resultat_1h[\"D_T_collectif\"]\n","        -\n","        D_T\n","    )\n",")\n","\n","print(\n","    \"\\nVérification du cas Δt = 1 heure :\"\n",")\n","\n","print(\n","    \"D_T multi-pas identique au D_T initial :\",\n","    verification_D_T_1h\n",")\n","\n","print(\n","    \"Erreur maximale :\",\n","    f\"{erreur_D_T_1h:.3e}\"\n",")\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 8. Test de proportionnalité locale D_T ~ Delta t\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","D_mean_1h = (\n","    resultat_1h[\"stats_collectif\"][\"D_T_mean\"]\n",")\n","\n","lignes_scaling = []\n","\n","for lag, resultat in resultats_multi_pas.items():\n","\n","    delta_t = resultat[\"Delta_t_heures\"]\n","\n","    D_mean_observe = (\n","        resultat[\"stats_collectif\"][\"D_T_mean\"]\n","    )\n","\n","    # Valeur attendue sous croissance strictement linéaire\n","    D_mean_lineaire = (\n","        D_mean_1h\n","        *\n","        delta_t\n","    )\n","\n","    ratio_scaling = (\n","        D_mean_observe\n","        /\n","        D_mean_lineaire\n","    )\n","\n","    ecart_relatif = (\n","        ratio_scaling\n","        -\n","        1.0\n","    )\n","\n","    lignes_scaling.append({\n","        \"Delta_t_heures\": delta_t,\n","        \"D_T_mean_observe\": D_mean_observe,\n","        \"D_T_mean_lineaire\": D_mean_lineaire,\n","        \"Ratio_observe_lineaire\": ratio_scaling,\n","        \"Ecart_relatif\": ecart_relatif,\n","        \"Ecart_relatif_percent\":\n","            100.0 * ecart_relatif\n","    })\n","\n","resume_scaling = pd.DataFrame(\n","    lignes_scaling\n",")\n","\n","print(\n","    \"\\nTest de croissance locale D_T ∝ Δt :\"\n",")\n","\n","display(\n","    resume_scaling\n",")\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 9. Graphique : moyenne de D_T selon le pas temporel\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","plt.figure(\n","    figsize=(9, 5)\n",")\n","\n","plt.plot(\n","    resume_multi_pas_collectif[\"Delta_t_heures\"],\n","    resume_multi_pas_collectif[\"D_T_mean\"],\n","    marker=\"o\",\n","    label=\"D_T moyen observé\"\n",")\n","\n","plt.plot(\n","    resume_scaling[\"Delta_t_heures\"],\n","    resume_scaling[\"D_T_mean_lineaire\"],\n","    marker=\"s\",\n","    linestyle=\"--\",\n","    label=\"Référence linéaire issue de 1 h\"\n",")\n","\n","plt.xlabel(\n","    \"Pas temporel Δt (heures)\"\n",")\n","\n","plt.ylabel(\n","    \"D_T moyen\"\n",")\n","\n","plt.title(\n","    \"Robustesse de D_T au changement du pas temporel\"\n",")\n","\n","plt.grid(\n","    alpha=0.3\n",")\n","\n","plt.legend()\n","\n","plt.tight_layout()\n","\n","plt.show()\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 10. Conclusion du test de robustesse temporelle\n","\n","Les observables GVH ont été recalculées pour les pas temporels\n","\n","\\[\n","\\Delta t\n","\\in\n","\\{1,2,3,6,12,24\\}\\ \\mathrm{heures},\n","\\]\n","\n","en maintenant fixe l'opérateur de normalisation.\n","\n","Pour les petits pas, la moyenne de la norme de transition suit\n","approximativement une croissance linéaire :\n","\n","\\[\n","\\overline{D_T^{(\\Delta t)}}\n","\\approx\n","\\Delta t\\,\n","\\overline{D_T^{(1h)}}.\n","\\]\n","\n","L'écart à cette référence reste inférieur à \\(1\\%\\) jusqu'à trois\n","heures. Il atteint environ \\(2.57\\%\\) à six heures, \\(10.13\\%\\) à\n","douze heures et \\(35.07\\%\\) à vingt-quatre heures.\n","\n","Cette croissance sous-linéaire aux pas plus grands est compatible avec\n","la courbure de la trajectoire dans l'espace d'état normalisé. En effet,\n","\\(D_T^{(\\Delta t)}\\) mesure la distance directe entre deux états, et\n","non la longueur totale de la trajectoire entre ces états.\n","\n","La variabilité relative collective diminue régulièrement :\n","\n","\\[\n","S_T^{\\mathrm{norm}}\n","=\n","0.389119\\%\n","\\quad\\text{à }1\\text{ heure},\n","\\]\n","\n","et\n","\n","\\[\n","S_T^{\\mathrm{norm}}\n","=\n","0.237436\\%\n","\\quad\\text{à }24\\text{ heures}.\n","\\]\n","\n","La faible dispersion relative de l'amplitude de transition persiste\n","donc sur toutes les résolutions testées.\n","\n","Europa conserve la plus forte variabilité relative, tandis que\n","Ganymède présente une stabilité particulièrement élevée. À vingt-quatre\n","heures, Io devient relativement moins variable que Ganymède, ce qui\n","montre que la hiérarchie de \\(S_T^{\\mathrm{norm}}\\) dépend partiellement\n","de l'échelle temporelle.\n","\n","Ces résultats établissent la cohérence et la robustesse descriptive\n","multi-échelle de \\(D_T\\), \\(S_T\\) et \\(S_T^{\\mathrm{norm}}\\) pour le\n","benchmark étudié. Ils ne constituent toutefois pas encore une preuve\n","d'invariance, de chaos, de perturbation spécifique ou de capacité\n","prédictive."],"metadata":{"id":"R8YVFFuwHgBG"}},{"cell_type":"markdown","source":["### Robustesse aux opérateurs de normalisation\n","\n","L'observable de transition dépend de l'opérateur de normalisation\n","appliqué à l'espace d'état. Pour un opérateur \\(\\mathcal N\\), on\n","définit\n","\n","\\[\n","\\widetilde X_k^{(\\mathcal N)}\n","=\n","\\mathcal N(X_k),\n","\\]\n","\n","puis\n","\n","\\[\n","\\boxed{\n","D_T^{(\\mathcal N,\\Delta t)}(k)\n","=\n","\\left\\|\n","\\widetilde X_{k+\\Delta k}^{(\\mathcal N)}\n","-\n","\\widetilde X_k^{(\\mathcal N)}\n","\\right\\|_2\n","}\n","\\]\n","\n","où \\(\\Delta k\\) représente le nombre de pas élémentaires séparant les\n","deux états.\n","\n","Trois familles de normalisation sont comparées.\n","\n","#### Normalisation z-score\n","\n","Pour chaque composante \\(j\\),\n","\n","\\[\n","\\mathcal N_{\\mathrm{zscore}}(X_{k,j})\n","=\n","\\frac{X_{k,j}-\\mu_j}{\\sigma_j}.\n","\\]\n","\n","Cette normalisation attribue une variance unitaire à chaque composante.\n","\n","#### Normalisation min-max\n","\n","Pour chaque composante \\(j\\),\n","\n","\\[\n","\\mathcal N_{\\mathrm{minmax}}(X_{k,j})\n","=\n","\\frac{\n","X_{k,j}-X_{j,\\min}\n","}{\n","X_{j,\\max}-X_{j,\\min}\n","}.\n","\\]\n","\n","Chaque composante est ainsi projetée dans l'intervalle \\([0,1]\\).\n","\n","#### Normalisation physique\n","\n","Pour chaque satellite \\(a\\), on définit une longueur caractéristique\n","\\(L_a\\) et une vitesse caractéristique \\(V_a\\), puis\n","\n","\\[\n","\\mathcal N_{\\mathrm{physique}}\n","(\\mathbf r_a,\\mathbf v_a)\n","=\n","\\left(\n","\\frac{\\mathbf r_a}{L_a},\n","\\frac{\\mathbf v_a}{V_a}\n","\\right).\n","\\]\n","\n","Dans cette première expérience, les échelles caractéristiques sont\n","estimées à partir de la médiane du rayon orbital et de la médiane de la\n","norme de vitesse sur la fenêtre étudiée :\n","\n","\\[\n","L_a\n","=\n","\\operatorname{median}\n","\\left(\n","\\|\\mathbf r_a(k)\\|\n","\\right),\n","\\]\n","\n","\\[\n","V_a\n","=\n","\\operatorname{median}\n","\\left(\n","\\|\\mathbf v_a(k)\\|\n","\\right).\n","\\]\n","\n","Cette normalisation est physiquement interprétable, mais reste\n","dépendante de la fenêtre de données. Elle constitue donc une première\n","normalisation physique de benchmark, et non encore une normalisation\n","canonique définitive de GVH."],"metadata":{"id":"BAsTqqNLHkmy"}},{"cell_type":"code","source":["# ============================================================\n","# Robustesse de D_T, S_T et S_T_norm aux normalisations\n","#\n","# Normalisations comparées :\n","# 1. z-score\n","# 2. min-max\n","# 3. physique\n","#\n","# Expérience factorielle :\n","# normalisation × pas temporel\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","import numpy as np\n","import pandas as pd\n","import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 1. Préparation et contrôles de l'état collectif brut\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","X_brut = np.asarray(\n","    X_collectif,\n","    dtype=float\n",")\n","\n","if X_brut.ndim != 2:\n","    raise ValueError(\n","        \"X_collectif doit être une matrice bidimensionnelle.\"\n","    )\n","\n","if X_brut.shape[1] != 18:\n","    raise ValueError(\n","        \"X_collectif doit contenir exactement 18 composantes.\"\n","    )\n","\n","if not np.isfinite(X_brut).all():\n","    raise ValueError(\n","        \"X_collectif contient des valeurs non finies.\"\n","    )\n","\n","n_etats, dimension = X_brut.shape\n","\n","print(\"Nombre d'états bruts :\", n_etats)\n","print(\"Dimension de l'état collectif :\", dimension)\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 2. Normalisation z-score\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","def normalisation_zscore(X):\n","    \"\"\"\n","    Normalisation composante par composante :\n","\n","        X_norm = (X - moyenne) / écart-type\n","\n","    L'écart-type population est utilisé : ddof = 0.\n","    \"\"\"\n","\n","    moyenne = np.mean(\n","        X,\n","        axis=0\n","    )\n","\n","    ecart_type = np.std(\n","        X,\n","        axis=0,\n","        ddof=0\n","    )\n","\n","    if np.any(\n","        np.isclose(ecart_type, 0.0)\n","    ):\n","        indices = np.where(\n","            np.isclose(ecart_type, 0.0)\n","        )[0]\n","\n","        raise ValueError(\n","            \"Écart-type nul pour les composantes : \"\n","            f\"{indices.tolist()}\"\n","        )\n","\n","    X_norm = (\n","        X - moyenne\n","    ) / ecart_type\n","\n","    parametres = {\n","        \"moyenne\": moyenne,\n","        \"ecart_type\": ecart_type\n","    }\n","\n","    return X_norm, parametres\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 3. Normalisation min-max\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","def normalisation_minmax(X):\n","    \"\"\"\n","    Normalisation composante par composante dans [0,1] :\n","\n","        X_norm = (X - minimum) / (maximum - minimum)\n","    \"\"\"\n","\n","    minimum = np.min(\n","        X,\n","        axis=0\n","    )\n","\n","    maximum = np.max(\n","        X,\n","        axis=0\n","    )\n","\n","    amplitude = (\n","        maximum - minimum\n","    )\n","\n","    if np.any(\n","        np.isclose(amplitude, 0.0)\n","    ):\n","        indices = np.where(\n","            np.isclose(amplitude, 0.0)\n","        )[0]\n","\n","        raise ValueError(\n","            \"Amplitude nulle pour les composantes : \"\n","            f\"{indices.tolist()}\"\n","        )\n","\n","    X_norm = (\n","        X - minimum\n","    ) / amplitude\n","\n","    parametres = {\n","        \"minimum\": minimum,\n","        \"maximum\": maximum,\n","        \"amplitude\": amplitude\n","    }\n","\n","    return X_norm, parametres\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 4. Estimation des échelles physiques\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","def estimer_echelles_physiques(X):\n","    \"\"\"\n","    Estime, pour chaque satellite :\n","\n","        L_a = médiane(||r_a||)\n","        V_a = médiane(||v_a||)\n","\n","    L'ordre supposé des colonnes est :\n","\n","        Io        : x, y, z, vx, vy, vz\n","        Europa    : x, y, z, vx, vy, vz\n","        Ganymede  : x, y, z, vx, vy, vz\n","    \"\"\"\n","\n","    noms = [\n","        \"Io\",\n","        \"Europa\",\n","        \"Ganymede\"\n","    ]\n","\n","    echelles = {}\n","\n","    for i, nom in enumerate(noms):\n","\n","        debut = 6 * i\n","\n","        positions = X[\n","            :,\n","            debut:debut + 3\n","        ]\n","\n","        vitesses = X[\n","            :,\n","            debut + 3:debut + 6\n","        ]\n","\n","        rayons = np.linalg.norm(\n","            positions,\n","            axis=1\n","        )\n","\n","        normes_vitesse = np.linalg.norm(\n","            vitesses,\n","            axis=1\n","        )\n","\n","        L_a = np.median(\n","            rayons\n","        )\n","\n","        V_a = np.median(\n","            normes_vitesse\n","        )\n","\n","        if (\n","            not np.isfinite(L_a)\n","            or\n","            not np.isfinite(V_a)\n","            or\n","            L_a <= 0\n","            or\n","            V_a <= 0\n","        ):\n","            raise ValueError(\n","                f\"Échelles physiques invalides pour {nom}.\"\n","            )\n","\n","        echelles[nom] = {\n","            \"L\": L_a,\n","            \"V\": V_a\n","        }\n","\n","    return echelles\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 5. Normalisation physique\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","def normalisation_physique(\n","    X,\n","    echelles=None\n","):\n","    \"\"\"\n","    Normalisation par satellite :\n","\n","        r_tilde = r / L_a\n","        v_tilde = v / V_a\n","\n","    Si aucune échelle n'est fournie, elles sont estimées à partir\n","    des médianes du rayon et de la norme de vitesse.\n","    \"\"\"\n","\n","    if echelles is None:\n","        echelles = estimer_echelles_physiques(\n","            X\n","        )\n","\n","    noms = [\n","        \"Io\",\n","        \"Europa\",\n","        \"Ganymede\"\n","    ]\n","\n","    X_norm = np.empty_like(\n","        X,\n","        dtype=float\n","    )\n","\n","    for i, nom in enumerate(noms):\n","\n","        debut = 6 * i\n","\n","        L_a = echelles[nom][\"L\"]\n","        V_a = echelles[nom][\"V\"]\n","\n","        X_norm[\n","            :,\n","            debut:debut + 3\n","        ] = (\n","            X[\n","                :,\n","                debut:debut + 3\n","            ]\n","            /\n","            L_a\n","        )\n","\n","        X_norm[\n","            :,\n","            debut + 3:debut + 6\n","        ] = (\n","            X[\n","                :,\n","                debut + 3:debut + 6\n","            ]\n","            /\n","            V_a\n","        )\n","\n","    return X_norm, echelles\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 6. Application des trois normalisations\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","X_zscore, parametres_zscore = (\n","    normalisation_zscore(\n","        X_brut\n","    )\n",")\n","\n","X_minmax, parametres_minmax = (\n","    normalisation_minmax(\n","        X_brut\n","    )\n",")\n","\n","echelles_physiques = (\n","    estimer_echelles_physiques(\n","        X_brut\n","    )\n",")\n","\n","X_physique, parametres_physiques = (\n","    normalisation_physique(\n","        X_brut,\n","        echelles=echelles_physiques\n","    )\n",")\n","\n","normalisations = {\n","    \"zscore\": X_zscore,\n","    \"minmax\": X_minmax,\n","    \"physique\": X_physique\n","}\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 7. Contrôle des normalisations\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","print(\"\\nContrôles des normalisations :\")\n","\n","for nom, X_norm in normalisations.items():\n","\n","    print(\n","        f\"- {nom:10s} | \"\n","        f\"forme = {X_norm.shape} | \"\n","        f\"finie = {np.isfinite(X_norm).all()}\"\n","    )\n","\n","\n","# Vérification spécifique du z-score\n","print(\n","    \"\\nZ-score — maximum des moyennes absolues :\",\n","    f\"{np.max(np.abs(np.mean(X_zscore, axis=0))):.3e}\"\n",")\n","\n","print(\n","    \"Z-score — erreur maximale sur les écarts-types :\",\n","    f\"{np.max(np.abs(np.std(X_zscore, axis=0) - 1.0)):.3e}\"\n",")\n","\n","\n","# Vérification spécifique du min-max\n","print(\n","    \"\\nMin-max — minimum global :\",\n","    np.min(X_minmax)\n",")\n","\n","print(\n","    \"Min-max — maximum global :\",\n","    np.max(X_minmax)\n",")\n","\n","\n","# Tableau des échelles physiques\n","table_echelles_physiques = pd.DataFrame([\n","    {\n","        \"Satellite\": satellite,\n","        \"L_caracteristique\": valeurs[\"L\"],\n","        \"V_caracteristique\": valeurs[\"V\"]\n","    }\n","    for satellite, valeurs\n","    in echelles_physiques.items()\n","])\n","\n","print(\n","    \"\\nÉchelles de la normalisation physique :\"\n",")\n","\n","display(\n","    table_echelles_physiques\n",")\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 8. Fonction de calcul des observables\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","def calculer_observables_normalisation(\n","    X_norm,\n","    lag,\n","    nom_normalisation\n","):\n","    \"\"\"\n","    Calcule les observables GVH pour une normalisation et un lag.\n","\n","    Retourne les observables collectives et individuelles.\n","    \"\"\"\n","\n","    if lag <= 0:\n","        raise ValueError(\n","            \"lag doit être strictement positif.\"\n","        )\n","\n","    if lag >= X_norm.shape[0]:\n","        raise ValueError(\n","            \"lag est trop grand.\"\n","        )\n","\n","    Delta = (\n","        X_norm[lag:, :]\n","        -\n","        X_norm[:-lag, :]\n","    )\n","\n","    groupes = {\n","        \"Collectif\": Delta,\n","        \"Io\": Delta[:, 0:6],\n","        \"Europa\": Delta[:, 6:12],\n","        \"Ganymede\": Delta[:, 12:18]\n","    }\n","\n","    resultats = {}\n","\n","    for systeme, Delta_systeme in groupes.items():\n","\n","        D = np.linalg.norm(\n","            Delta_systeme,\n","            axis=1\n","        )\n","\n","        moyenne = np.mean(D)\n","\n","        S_T = np.std(\n","            D,\n","            ddof=0\n","        )\n","\n","        S_T_norm = (\n","            S_T / moyenne\n","            if not np.isclose(moyenne, 0.0)\n","            else np.nan\n","        )\n","\n","        resultats[systeme] = {\n","            \"Normalisation\": nom_normalisation,\n","            \"Systeme\": systeme,\n","            \"Delta_t_heures\": float(lag),\n","            \"N_transitions\": D.size,\n","            \"D_T_mean\": moyenne,\n","            \"S_T\": S_T,\n","            \"S_T_norm\": S_T_norm,\n","            \"S_T_norm_percent\": 100.0 * S_T_norm,\n","            \"D_T_min\": np.min(D),\n","            \"D_T_median\": np.median(D),\n","            \"D_T_max\": np.max(D),\n","            \"D_T_serie\": D\n","        }\n","\n","    # Vérification de la décomposition collective\n","    D_collectif = resultats[\"Collectif\"][\"D_T_serie\"]\n","    D_Io = resultats[\"Io\"][\"D_T_serie\"]\n","    D_Europa = resultats[\"Europa\"][\"D_T_serie\"]\n","    D_Ganymede = resultats[\"Ganymede\"][\"D_T_serie\"]\n","\n","    D_reconstruit = np.sqrt(\n","        D_Io**2\n","        +\n","        D_Europa**2\n","        +\n","        D_Ganymede**2\n","    )\n","\n","    erreur_decomposition = np.max(\n","        np.abs(\n","            D_collectif\n","            -\n","            D_reconstruit\n","        )\n","    )\n","\n","    decomposition_validee = np.allclose(\n","        D_collectif,\n","        D_reconstruit,\n","        rtol=1e-13,\n","        atol=1e-13\n","    )\n","\n","    return (\n","        resultats,\n","        decomposition_validee,\n","        erreur_decomposition\n","    )\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 9. Première comparaison : pas fixe de 1 heure\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","lignes_1h = []\n","series_1h = {}\n","\n","for nom_normalisation, X_norm in normalisations.items():\n","\n","    (\n","        resultats,\n","        decomposition_validee,\n","        erreur_decomposition\n","    ) = calculer_observables_normalisation(\n","        X_norm=X_norm,\n","        lag=1,\n","        nom_normalisation=nom_normalisation\n","    )\n","\n","    series_1h[nom_normalisation] = {\n","        systeme: valeurs[\"D_T_serie\"]\n","        for systeme, valeurs\n","        in resultats.items()\n","    }\n","\n","    for systeme, valeurs in resultats.items():\n","\n","        lignes_1h.append({\n","            \"Normalisation\":\n","                nom_normalisation,\n","            \"Systeme\":\n","                systeme,\n","            \"Delta_t_heures\":\n","                valeurs[\"Delta_t_heures\"],\n","            \"N_transitions\":\n","                valeurs[\"N_transitions\"],\n","            \"D_T_mean\":\n","                valeurs[\"D_T_mean\"],\n","            \"S_T\":\n","                valeurs[\"S_T\"],\n","            \"S_T_norm\":\n","                valeurs[\"S_T_norm\"],\n","            \"S_T_norm_percent\":\n","                valeurs[\"S_T_norm_percent\"],\n","            \"D_T_min\":\n","                valeurs[\"D_T_min\"],\n","            \"D_T_median\":\n","                valeurs[\"D_T_median\"],\n","            \"D_T_max\":\n","                valeurs[\"D_T_max\"],\n","            \"Decomposition_validee\":\n","                decomposition_validee,\n","            \"Erreur_decomposition\":\n","                erreur_decomposition\n","        })\n","\n","resume_normalisations_1h = pd.DataFrame(\n","    lignes_1h\n",")\n","\n","print(\n","    \"\\nComparaison des normalisations à Δt = 1 heure :\"\n",")\n","\n","display(\n","    resume_normalisations_1h\n",")\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 10. Vérification du z-score historique\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","D_zscore_1h = (\n","    series_1h[\"zscore\"][\"Collectif\"]\n",")\n","\n","verification_zscore_historique = np.allclose(\n","    D_zscore_1h,\n","    D_T,\n","    rtol=1e-14,\n","    atol=1e-14\n",")\n","\n","erreur_zscore_historique = np.max(\n","    np.abs(\n","        D_zscore_1h\n","        -\n","        D_T\n","    )\n",")\n","\n","print(\n","    \"\\nVérification du benchmark historique :\"\n",")\n","\n","print(\n","    \"Le z-score reproduit exactement D_T initial :\",\n","    verification_zscore_historique\n",")\n","\n","print(\n","    \"Erreur maximale :\",\n","    f\"{erreur_zscore_historique:.3e}\"\n",")\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 11. Corrélations temporelles entre normalisations\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","noms_normalisations = list(\n","    normalisations.keys()\n",")\n","\n","matrice_correlation = np.empty(\n","    (\n","        len(noms_normalisations),\n","        len(noms_normalisations)\n","    )\n",")\n","\n","for i, nom_a in enumerate(\n","    noms_normalisations\n","):\n","\n","    for j, nom_b in enumerate(\n","        noms_normalisations\n","    ):\n","\n","        D_a = series_1h[\n","            nom_a\n","        ][\"Collectif\"]\n","\n","        D_b = series_1h[\n","            nom_b\n","        ][\"Collectif\"]\n","\n","        matrice_correlation[\n","            i,\n","            j\n","        ] = np.corrcoef(\n","            D_a,\n","            D_b\n","        )[0, 1]\n","\n","correlations_normalisations = pd.DataFrame(\n","    matrice_correlation,\n","    index=noms_normalisations,\n","    columns=noms_normalisations\n",")\n","\n","print(\n","    \"\\nCorrélations de D_T collectif entre normalisations :\"\n",")\n","\n","display(\n","    correlations_normalisations\n",")\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 12. Comparaison des rangs temporels\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","def correlation_spearman_sans_scipy(\n","    x,\n","    y\n","):\n","    \"\"\"\n","    Corrélation de Spearman calculée à partir des rangs pandas.\n","    \"\"\"\n","\n","    rang_x = pd.Series(\n","        x\n","    ).rank(\n","        method=\"average\"\n","    )\n","\n","    rang_y = pd.Series(\n","        y\n","    ).rank(\n","        method=\"average\"\n","    )\n","\n","    return np.corrcoef(\n","        rang_x,\n","        rang_y\n","    )[0, 1]\n","\n","\n","lignes_spearman = []\n","\n","for i, nom_a in enumerate(\n","    noms_normalisations\n","):\n","\n","    for nom_b in noms_normalisations[\n","        i + 1:\n","    ]:\n","\n","        rho = correlation_spearman_sans_scipy(\n","            series_1h[nom_a][\"Collectif\"],\n","            series_1h[nom_b][\"Collectif\"]\n","        )\n","\n","        lignes_spearman.append({\n","            \"Normalisation_A\": nom_a,\n","            \"Normalisation_B\": nom_b,\n","            \"Spearman_rho\": rho\n","        })\n","\n","correlations_spearman = pd.DataFrame(\n","    lignes_spearman\n",")\n","\n","print(\n","    \"\\nConservation du classement temporel des transitions :\"\n",")\n","\n","display(\n","    correlations_spearman\n",")\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 13. Expérience complète :\n","#     normalisation × pas temporel\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","pas_heures = [\n","    1,\n","    2,\n","    3,\n","    6,\n","    12,\n","    24\n","]\n","\n","lignes_factorielles = []\n","\n","for nom_normalisation, X_norm in normalisations.items():\n","\n","    for lag in pas_heures:\n","\n","        (\n","           nom_normalisation=nom_normalisation\n","        )\n","\n","        for systeme, valeurs in resultats.items():\n","\n","            lignes_factorielles.append({\n"," :\n","\n","\\[\n","\\mathcal N_{\\mathrm{zscore}},\n","\\qquad\n","\\mathcal N_{\\mathrm{minmax}},\n","\\qquad\n","\\mathcal N_{\\mathrm{physique}}.\n","\\]\n","\n","Les valeurs absolues de \\(D_T\\) À une heure, la moyenne collective vaut\n","\n","\\[\n","0.414467\n","\\]\n","\n","pour le z-score,\n","\n","\\[\n","0.145656\n","\\]\n","\n","pour le min-max, et\n","\n","\\[\n","0.239295\n","\\]\n","\n","pour la normalisation physique.\n","\n","Ces différences confirment que \\(D_T\\) et \\(S_T\\) dépendent de la\n","géométrie métrique imposée par l'opérateur de normalisation.\n","\n","En revanche, la structure temporelle des transitions est fortement\n","conservée. Les corrélations linéaires entre les séries collectives sont\n","supérieures à \\(0.993\\), et les corrélations de rang sont supérieures à\n","\\(0.988\\).\n","\n","La variabilité relative\n","\n","\\[\n","S_T^{\\mathrm{norm}}\n","=\n","\\frac{S_T}{\\overline{D_T}}\n","\\]\n","\n","présente une robustesse encore plus forte. :\n","\n","\\[\n","\\text{les amplitudes absolues, dépendantes de la normalisation,}\n","\\]\n","\n","et\n","\n","\\[\n","\\text{la structure relative des transitions, largement
