normalisations\n","\n","Les états sont séparés chronologiquement en deux ensembles :\n","\n","\\[\n","\\mathcal D_{\\mathrm{train}}\n","=\n","\\{X_0,\\ldots,X_{n_{\\mathrm{train}}-1}\\},\n","\\]\n","\n","et\n","\n","\\[\n","\\mathcal D_{\\mathrm{test}}\n","=\n","\\{X_{n_{\\mathrm{train}}},\\ldots,X_{N-1}\\}.\n","\\]\n","\n","Pour chaque opérateur de normalisation, les paramètres sont estimés\n","exclusivement sur la période d'apprentissage :\n","\n","\\[\n","\\widehat\\Theta_{\\mathcal N}\n","=\n","\\operatorname{fit}\n","\\left(\n","\\mathcal D_{\\mathrm{train}}\n","\\right).\n","\\]\n","\n","Ces paramètres sont ensuite gelés et appliqués aux deux périodes :\n","\n","\\[\n","\\widetilde X_k^{\\mathrm{train}}\n","=\n","\\mathcal N_{\\widehat\\Theta_{\\mathcal N}}\n","\\left(\n","X_k^{\\mathrm{train}}\n","\\right),\n","\\]\n","\n","\\[\n","\\widetilde X_k^{\\mathrm{test}}\n","=\n","\\mathcal N_{\\widehat\\Theta_{\\mathcal N}}\n","\\left(\n","X_k^{\\mathrm{test}}\n","\\right).\n","\\]\n","\n","Aucun paramètre de normalisation n'est recalculé sur la période de\n","test.\n","\n","Pour chaque période, on calcule\n","\n","\\[\n","D_T(k)\n","=\n","\\left\\|\n","\\widetilde X_{k+1}\n","-\n","\\widetilde X_k\n","\\right\\|_2,\n","\\]\n","\n","\\[\n","S_T\n","=\n","\\operatorname{std}(D_T),\n","\\]\n","\n","et\n","\n","\\[\n","S_T^{\\mathrm{norm}}\n","=\n","\\frac{S_T}{\\overline{D_T}}.\n","\\]\n","\n","La stabilité hors échantillon est évaluée à partir des rapports\n","\n","\\[\n","R_D\n","=\n","\\frac{\n","\\overline{D_T}^{\\,\\mathrm{test}}\n","}{\n","\\overline{D_T}^{\\,\\mathrm{train}}\n","},\n","\\]\n","\n","\\[\n","R_S\n","=\n","\\frac{\n","S_T^{\\mathrm{test}}\n","}{\n","S_T^{\\mathrm{train}}\n","},\n","\\]\n","\n","et\n","\n","\\[\n","R_{S,\\mathrm{norm}}\n","=\n","\\frac{\n","S_{T,\\mathrm{norm}}^{\\mathrm{test}}\n","}{\n","S_{T,\\mathrm{norm}}^{\\mathrm{train}}\n","}.\n","\\]\n","\n","Des rapports proches de \\(1\\) indiquent une stabilité descriptive entre\n","les deux périodes. Ils ne constituent cependant pas, à eux seuls, une\n","preuve d'invariance physique."],"metadata":{"id":"dbLoYgM3jetO"}},{"cell_type":"code","source":["# ============================================================\n","# Validation hors échantillon des normalisations GVH\n","#\n","# Séparation chronologique :\n","# - 80 % apprentissage\n","# - 20 % test\n","#\n","# Les paramètres sont calculés sur train uniquement,\n","# puis appliqués sans recalcul sur test.\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","import numpy as np\n","import pandas as pd\n","import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 1. Préparation des données\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","X_brut = np.asarray(\n","    X_collectif,\n","    dtype=float\n",")\n","\n","if X_brut.ndim != 2:\n","    raise ValueError(\n","        \"X_collectif doit être une matrice bidimensionnelle.\"\n","    )\n","\n","if X_brut.shape[1] != 18:\n","    raise ValueError(\n","        \"X_collectif doit contenir 18 composantes.\"\n","    )\n","\n","if not np.isfinite(X_brut).all():\n","    raise ValueError(\n","        \"X_collectif contient des valeurs non finies.\"\n","    )\n","\n","N_etats = X_brut.shape[0]\n","\n","fraction_train = 0.80\n","\n","indice_separation = int(\n","    np.floor(\n","        fraction_train * N_etats\n","    )\n",")\n","\n","if indice_separation < 2:\n","    raise ValueError(\n","        \"La période d'apprentissage est trop courte.\"\n","    )\n","\n","if N_etats - indice_separation < 2:\n","    raise ValueError(\n","        \"La période de test est trop courte.\"\n","    )\n","\n","X_train_brut = X_brut[\n","    :indice_separation\n","]\n","\n","X_test_brut = X_brut[\n","    indice_separation:\n","]\n","\n","print(\"Séparation chronologique :\")\n","print(\n","    f\"- Nombre total d'états : {N_etats}\"\n",")\n","print(\n","    f\"- États d'apprentissage : {X_train_brut.shape[0]}\"\n",")\n","print(\n","    f\"- États de test : {X_test_brut.shape[0]}\"\n",")\n","print(\n","    f\"- Indice de séparation : {indice_separation}\"\n",")\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 2. Ajustement et application du z-score\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","def ajuster_zscore(X_train):\n","    moyenne = np.mean(\n","        X_train,\n","        axis=0\n","    )\n","\n","    ecart_type = np.std(\n","        X_train,\n","        axis=0,\n","        ddof=0\n","    )\n","\n","    if np.any(\n","        np.isclose(ecart_type, 0.0)\n","    ):\n","        indices = np.where(\n","            np.isclose(ecart_type, 0.0)\n","        )[0]\n","\n","        raise ValueError(\n","            \"Écart-type nul dans train pour les composantes : \"\n","            f\"{indices.tolist()}\"\n","        )\n","\n","    return {\n","        \"moyenne\": moyenne,\n","        \"ecart_type\": ecart_type\n","    }\n","\n","\n","def appliquer_zscore(X, parametres):\n","    return (\n","        X - parametres[\"moyenne\"]\n","    ) / parametres[\"ecart_type\"]\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 3. Ajustement et application du min-max\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","def ajuster_minmax(X_train):\n","    minimum = np.min(\n","        X_train,\n","        axis=0\n","    )\n","\n","    maximum = np.max(\n","        X_train,\n","        axis=0\n","    )\n","\n","    amplitude = (\n","        maximum - minimum\n","    )\n","\n","    if np.any(\n","        np.isclose(amplitude, 0.0)\n","    ):\n","        indices = np.where(\n","            np.isclose(amplitude, 0.0)\n","        )[0]\n","\n","        raise ValueError(\n","            \"Amplitude nulle dans train pour les composantes : \"\n","            f\"{indices.tolist()}\"\n","        )\n","\n","    return {\n","        \"minimum\": minimum,\n","        \"maximum\": maximum,\n","        \"amplitude\": amplitude\n","    }\n","\n","\n","def appliquer_minmax(X, parametres):\n","    return (\n","        X - parametres[\"minimum\"]\n","    ) / parametres[\"amplitude\"]\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 4. Ajustement et application de la normalisation physique\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","def ajuster_normalisation_physique(X_train):\n","    noms = [\n","        \"Io\",\n","        \"Europa\",\n","        \"Ganymede\"\n","    ]\n","\n","    echelles = {}\n","\n","    for i, nom in enumerate(noms):\n","\n","        debut = 6 * i\n","\n","        positions = X_train[\n","            :,\n","            debut:debut + 3\n","        ]\n","\n","        vitesses = X_train[\n","            :,\n","            debut + 3:debut + 6\n","        ]\n","\n","        rayons = np.linalg.norm(\n","            positions,\n","            axis=1\n","        )\n","\n","        normes_vitesse = np.linalg.norm(\n","            vitesses,\n","            axis=1\n","        )\n","\n","        L_a = np.median(\n","            rayons\n","        )\n","\n","        V_a = np.median(\n","            normes_vitesse\n","        )\n","\n","        if (\n","            not np.isfinite(L_a)\n","            or\n","            not np.isfinite(V_a)\n","            or\n","            L_a <= 0\n","            or\n","            V_a <= 0\n","        ):\n","            raise ValueError(\n","                f\"Échelles physiques invalides pour {nom}.\"\n","            )\n","\n","        echelles[nom] = {\n","            \"L\": L_a,\n","            \"V\": V_a\n","        }\n","\n","    return echelles\n","\n","\n","def appliquer_normalisation_physique(\n","    X,\n","    echelles\n","):\n","    noms = [\n","        \"Io\",\n","        \"Europa\",\n","        \"Ganymede\"\n","    ]\n","\n","    X_norm = np.empty_like(\n","        X,\n","        dtype=float\n","    )\n","\n","    for i, nom in enumerate(noms):\n","\n","        debut = 6 * i\n","\n","        L_a = echelles[nom][\"L\"]\n","        V_a = echelles[nom][\"V\"]\n","\n","        X_norm[\n","            :,\n","            debut:debut + 3\n","        ] = (\n","            X[\n","                :,\n","                debut:debut + 3\n","            ]\n","            /\n","            L_a\n","        )\n","\n","        X_norm[\n","            :,\n","            debut + 3:debut + 6\n","        ] = (\n","            X[\n","                :,\n","                debut + 3:debut + 6\n","            ]\n","            /\n","            V_a\n","        )\n","\n","    return X_norm\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 5. Ajustement sur train uniquement\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","parametres_zscore_train = ajuster_zscore(\n","    X_train_brut\n",")\n","\n","parametres_minmax_train = ajuster_minmax(\n","    X_train_brut\n",")\n","\n","parametres_physiques_train = (\n","    ajuster_normalisation_physique(\n","        X_train_brut\n","    )\n",")\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 6. Application des paramètres gelés\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","X_train_zscore = appliquer_zscore(\n","    X_train_brut,\n","    parametres_zscore_train\n",")\n","\n","X_test_zscore = appliquer_zscore(\n","    X_test_brut,\n","    parametres_zscore_train\n",")\n","\n","X_train_minmax = appliquer_minmax(\n","    X_train_brut,\n","    parametres_minmax_train\n",")\n","\n","X_test_minmax = appliquer_minmax(\n","    X_test_brut,\n","    parametres_minmax_train\n",")\n","\n","X_train_physique = appliquer_normalisation_physique(\n","    X_train_brut,\n","    parametres_physiques_train\n",")\n","\n","X_test_physique = appliquer_normalisation_physique(\n","    X_test_brut,\n","    parametres_physiques_train\n",")\n","\n","donnees_normalisees = {\n","    \"zscore\": {\n","        \"train\": X_train_zscore,\n","        \"test\": X_test_zscore\n","    },\n","    \"minmax\": {\n","        \"train\": X_train_minmax,\n","        \"test\": X_test_minmax\n","    },\n","    \"physique\": {\n","        \"train\": X_train_physique,\n","        \"test\": X_test_physique\n","    }\n","}\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 7. Vérification de l'absence de recalcul sur test\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","print(\n","    \"\\nContrôles des ensembles normalisés :\"\n",")\n","\n","for normalisation, periodes in donnees_normalisees.items():\n","\n","    for periode, X_norm in periodes.items():\n","\n","        print(\n","            f\"- {normalisation:9s} | \"\n","            f\"{periode:5s} | \"\n","            f\"forme = {X_norm.shape} | \"\n","            f\"finie = {np.isfinite(X_norm).all()}\"\n","        )\n","\n","\n","# Un test min-max hors échantillon peut légitimement sortir de [0,1].\n","test_minmax_hors_intervalle = np.mean(\n","    (X_test_minmax < 0.0)\n","    |\n","    (X_test_minmax > 1.0)\n",")\n","\n","print(\n","    \"\\nProportion des valeurs min-max de test hors [0,1] :\",\n","    f\"{100 * test_minmax_hors_intervalle:.6f} %\"\n",")\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 8. Fonction de calcul des observables\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","def calculer_observables_periode(\n","    X_norm,\n","    normalisation,\n","    periode,\n","    lag=1\n","):\n","    \"\"\"\n","    Calcule D_T, S_T et S_T_norm pour une période.\n","    Les transitions restent internes à la période considérée.\n","    \"\"\"\n","\n","    if lag <= 0:\n","        raise ValueError(\n","            \"lag doit être strictement positif.\"\n","        )\n","\n","    if lag >= X_norm.shape[0]:\n","        raise ValueError(\n","            f\"{periode} : lag trop grand.\"\n","        )\n","\n","    Delta = (\n","        X_norm[lag:]\n","        -\n","        X_norm[:-lag]\n","    )\n","\n","    groupes = {\n","        \"Collectif\": Delta,\n","        \"Io\": Delta[:, 0:6],\n","        \"Europa\": Delta[:, 6:12],\n","        \"Ganymede\": Delta[:, 12:18]\n","    }\n","\n","    resultats = {}\n","    series = {}\n","\n","    for systeme, Delta_systeme in groupes.items():\n","\n","        D = np.linalg.norm(\n","            Delta_systeme,\n","            axis=1\n","        )\n","\n","        D_mean = np.mean(D)\n","\n","        S_T = np.std(\n","            D,\n","            ddof=0\n","        )\n","\n","        S_T_norm = (\n","            S_T / D_mean\n","            if not np.isclose(D_mean, 0.0)\n","            else np.nan\n","        )\n","\n","        resultats[systeme] = {\n","            \"Normalisation\": normalisation,\n","            \"Periode\": periode,\n","            \"Systeme\": systeme,\n","            \"Delta_t_heures\": float(lag),\n","            \"N_etats\": X_norm.shape[0],\n","            \"N_transitions\": D.size,\n","            \"D_T_mean\": D_mean,\n","            \"S_T\": S_T,\n","            \"S_T_norm\": S_T_norm,\n","            \"S_T_norm_percent\":\n","                100.0 * S_T_norm,\n","            \"D_T_min\": np.min(D),\n","            \"D_T_median\": np.median(D),\n","            \"D_T_max\": np.max(D)\n","        }\n","\n","        series[systeme] = D\n","\n","    # Décomposition quadratique\n","    D_collectif = series[\"Collectif\"]\n","\n","    D_reconstruit = np.sqrt(\n","        series[\"Io\"]**2\n","        +\n","        series[\"Europa\"]**2\n","        +\n","        series[\"Ganymede\"]**2\n","    )\n","\n","    erreur_decomposition = np.max(\n","        np.abs(\n","            D_collectif\n","            -\n","            D_reconstruit\n","        )\n","    )\n","\n","    decomposition_validee = np.allclose(\n","        D_collectif,\n","        D_reconstruit,\n","        rtol=1e-13,\n","        atol=1e-13\n","    )\n","\n","    return (\n","        resultats,\n","        series,\n","        decomposition_validee,\n","        erreur_decomposition\n","    )\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 9. Calcul train/test à Δt = 1 heure\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","lignes_resultats = []\n","series_hors_echantillon = {}\n","\n","for normalisation, periodes in donnees_normalisees.items():\n","\n","    series_hors_echantillon[\n","        normalisation\n","    ] = {}\n","\n","    for periode, X_norm in periodes.items():\n","\n","        (\n","            resultats,\n","            series,\n","            decomposition_validee,\n","            erreur_decomposition\n","        ) = calculer_observables_periode(\n","            X_norm=X_norm,\n","            normalisation=normalisation,\n","            periode=periode,\n","            lag=1\n","        )\n","\n","        series_hors_echantillon[\n","            normalisation\n","        ][periode] = series\n","\n","        for systeme, valeurs in resultats.items():\n","\n","            ligne = valeurs.copy()\n","\n","            ligne[\n","                \"Decomposition_validee\"\n","            ] = decomposition_validee\n","\n","            ligne[\n","                \"Erreur_decomposition\"\n","            ] = erreur_decomposition\n","\n","            lignes_resultats.append(\n","                ligne\n","            )\n","\n","resume_hors_echantillon = pd.DataFrame(\n","    lignes_resultats\n",")\n","\n","print(\n","    \"\\nObservables hors échantillon :\"\n",")\n","\n","display(\n","    resume_hors_echantillon\n",")\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 10. Tableau collectif train/test\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","resume_collectif_hors_echantillon = (\n","    resume_hors_echantillon[\n","        resume_hors_echantillon[\"Systeme\"]\n","        ==\n","        \"Collectif\"\n","    ]\n","    .reset_index(\n","        drop=True\n","    )\n",")\n","\n","print(\n","    \"\\nRésultats collectifs train/test :\"\n",")\n","\n","display(\n","    resume_collectif_hors_echantillon\n",")\n","\n","\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","# 11. Comparaison test / train\n","# ------------------------------------------------------------\n","\n","table_train = (\n","    resume_hors_echantillon[\n","        resume_hors_echantillon[\"Periode\"]\n","        ==\n","        \"train\"\n","    ][\n","        [\n","            \"Normalisation\",\n","            \"Systeme\",\n","            \"D_T_mean\",\n","            \"S_T\",\n","            \"S_T_norm\"\n","        ]\n","    ]\n","    .rename(\n","        columns={\n","            \"D_T_mean\": \"D_T_mean_train\",\n","            \"S_T\": \"S_T_train\",\n","            \"S_T_norm\": \"S_T_norm_train\"\n","        }\n","    )\n",")\n","\n","table_test = (\n","    resume_hors_echantillon[\n","        resume_hors_echantillon[\"Periode\"]\n","        ==\n","        \"test\"\n","    ][\n","        [\n","            \"Normalisation\",\n","            \"Systeme\",\n","            \"D_T_mean\",\n","            \"S_T\",\n","            \"S_T_norm\"\n","        ]\n","    ]\n","    .rename(\n","        columns={\n","            \"D_T_mean\": \"D_T_mean_test\",\n","            \"S_T\": \"S_T_test\",\n","            \"S_T_norm\": \"S_T_norm_test\"\n","        }\n","    )\n",")\n","\n","comparaison_train_test = table_train.merge(\n","    table_test,\n","    on=[\n","        \"Normalisation\",\n","        \"Systeme\"\n","    ],\n","    how=\"inner\"\n",")\n","\n","comparaison_train_test[\n","    \"Ratio_D_T_test_train\"\n","] = (\n","    comparaison_train_test[\"D_T_mean_test\"]\n","    /\n","    comparaison_train_test[\"D_T_mean_train\"]\n",")\n","\n","comparaison_train_test[\n","    \"Ratio_S_T_test_train\"\n","] = (\n","    comparaison_train_test[\"S_T_test\"]\n","    /\n","    comparaison_train_test[\"S_T_train\"]\n",")\n","\n","comparaison_train_test[\n","    \"Ratio_S_T_norm_test_train\"\n","] = (\n","    comparaison_train_test[\"S_T_norm_test\"]\n","    /\n","    comparaison_train_test[\"S_T_norm_train\"]\n",")\n","\n","comparaison_train_test[\n","    \"Variation_D_T_percent\"\n","] = (\n","    100.0\n","    *\n","    (\n","        comparaison_train_test[\n","            \"Ratio_D_T_test_train\"\n","        ]\n","        -\n","        1.0\n","    )\n",")\n","\n","comparaison_train_test[\n","    \"Variation_S_T_percent\"\n","] = (\n","    100.0\n","    *\n","    (\n","        comparaison_train_test[\n","            \"Ratio_S_T_test_train\"\n","        ]\n","        -\n","        1.0\n","    )\n",")\n","\n","comparaison_train_test[\n"," 1.0\n","    )\n",")\n","\n","print(\n","    \"\\nComparaison test / train :\"\n",")\n","\n","display(\n","    comparaison_train_test\n",")\n","\n","\n","#
